name: finstack
description: Adversarial investment research with memory. Argues both sides of a thesis, traces chain reactions across parallel causal paths, and measures what your execution costs you against a disciplined counterfactual.

interface.shortDescription: Investment research that argues back and remembers your blind spots
interface.longDescription:
Nine skills covering the full research loop: scan for signals that matter to your holdings, produce memorandums with traceable claims, subject a thesis to an adversarial bull-vs-bear exchange, size a position through a risk gate, trace an event's chain reactions, and separate luck from skill in your own decisions.

finstack maintains a shadow portfolio — a disciplined version of you that follows every plan exactly. The gap between it and your real trades is a number, attributed to a named behavioral pattern. That is the one thing a portfolio tracker cannot tell you.

All state lives in ~/.finstack as human-readable, git-tracked JSON. Works with no API keys; free keys unlock deeper data.

Use finstack to compare my real trades against my shadow portfolio
